messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: high error rate for service=api-frontend, symptom=TLS handshake failures + LB target unhealthy in us-west-2. Severity: P1. Policy: auto-escalate to oncall after 30s. https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Seeing spikes in 502/524 and a handful of TLS timeouts in logs. Looks like target health in the us-west-2 LB is flapping.

ben (sre): Adding context — autoscaling group for api-backend-usw2 shows 3/6 targets unhealthy, health checks failing on 443 with handshake errors. No recent deploys in the last 2 hours.

carmen (network): Looking at the ALB metrics — TLS_ResetCount and ELBAuthRejectedCount peaked at the same time. Any cert rotation today?

alice (oncall): Not from our side. certs/rotation service reports nothing. Could be an intermediate router or a change in upstream cipher negotiation. Running tcpdump on one unhealthy host now:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/usw2-handshake.pcap port 443 and host 10.32.5.12
```

david (infra): I'm tailing the instance logs. Kernel shows NIC flaps on i-0a1b2c3d (ENI detach then attach). Could be noisy path. Marking instance out of LB and draining.

incident-bot: auto-actions: removed instance i-0a1b2c3d from target group api-backend-usw2-tg. Notifying autoscaling for replace.

eva (support): Customer impact: a subset of US-West customers are seeing failures when invoking chat generation. We're tracking ~8% of requests failing with TLS handshake errors. Post a status notice?

alice (oncall): Put a short post to status with 'partial degradation in US-West affecting inference requests' and set pages to on. I'll coordinate mitigations first.

ben (sre): Quick mitigation idea: route traffic away from us-west-2 to us-east-1 with weight shift at the global LB layer and increase max connections there. We'll also temporarily raise the LB health check threshold to avoid flip-flopping on transient handshakes. Pros/cons?

carmen (network): I can update Route53 weighted policy to shift 70% to us-east-1 and 30% to us-west-2 for now. Also suggest lowering DNS TTL to 30s to speed subsequent adjustments. Will push change in 60s if no objections.

david (infra): Agree. Also let's spin new instances with the fixed AMI in us-west-2 and warm them behind the LB before shifting more traffic back.

alice (oncall): Go ahead with the DNS weight change and TTL drop. Ben — please update LB healthcheck config: increase healthy threshold to 4 and interval to 10s to reduce flapping. Carmen — coordinate DNS change. I'll notify customers after we observe error rate drop.

carmen (network): Executing DNS weight adjustment and TTL change now. Command: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-weight.json`. Applying in 10s.

deploy-bot: Deploy-trigger: started blue-green replacement of backend-asg-usw2 (ami: ami-0ff1a2b3) — 3 instances launching.

alice (oncall): Monitoring Uptime and error rate dashboards. If we don't see improvement in 10 minutes we'll escalate to infra/network on-call for deeper packet analysis.

ben (sre): Noted. Also creating a short eval set to check response correctness after failover — we don't want silent degradation.

eva (support): Status page draft: "Partial degradation in US-West: some requests may fail with TLS handshake errors. We're routing traffic to other regions and working on replacing affected hosts. Updates in ~10 minutes." Approve?

alice (oncall): Approve. Post it.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: acknowledgement recorded by alice (oncall). Next escalation window at 00:12 if no resolution.

carmen (network): Route53 change propagated (change id: /change/C123456789). TTL now 30s, weights adjusted. See console: https://console.aws.amazon/route53/change/C123456789

david (infra): New instances healthy and registered in TG. Draining old ones.

ben (sre): Error rate dropped from 8% -> 1.2% in last 3m after weight shift. TLS handshake errors on remaining hosts are rare.

alice (oncall): Good. Keep monitoring for 30min. Leaving incident as P1, but moving to 'mitigated'. Handoff: ben owns post-incident RCA, carmen owns network trace and Route53 timeline, david owns instance flapping investigation, eva will update customers with timeline. I'll remain available for exec updates.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. PagerDuty notes: incident closed at 2105004635 after manual resolution confirmation by alice (oncall).

eva (support): Posting finalized status update and emailing affected customers with mitigations and expected RCA ETA 24 hours. :white_check_mark:
